en.title: Getting started
en.description: Create your account, connect WhatsApp and invite your team.

articles.title: Create your account
articles.summary: Sign up, answer two quick questions and land on your dashboard.
articles.html:
Creating an OgaDesk account takes about a minute and needs no card.

Sign up

  1. Open the sign-up page and enter your name, work email and a password.
  2. Confirm your email using the link we send you.
  3. Answer the short welcome questions. If you came through a partner's link, we skip the "how did you hear about us" step.

Marketing emails

You can switch product news and offers on or off at any time under Settings → Your profile. Account and security emails are always sent.

Next step

Connect your WhatsApp number so conversations can start flowing into your inbox.

articles.title: Connect your WhatsApp number
articles.summary: Link a WhatsApp Business number through Meta so messages reach your inbox.
articles.html:
OgaDesk uses the official WhatsApp Business Platform from Meta, so your number stays yours.

Before you start

  • A Meta business account with a WhatsApp Business number.
  • Admin access to that Meta account.

Connect

  1. Go to Settings → WhatsApp.
  2. Choose to connect a number and follow the Meta sign-in window.
  3. Pick the business account and number to link, then confirm.

Once connected, new customer messages appear in your Inbox and you can reply from there.

Good to know

  • Your plan decides how many numbers you can connect.
  • Marketing messages to customers use approved templates, as required by WhatsApp.

articles.title: Invite your team
articles.summary: Add teammates and choose what each role can do.
articles.html:
Work together in one shared inbox by inviting teammates.

Invite

  1. Open Settings → Members.
  2. Enter a teammate's email and choose a role.
  3. They receive an invitation link and join your account in one click.

Roles

  • Owner and Admin manage settings, billing and members.
  • Agent handles conversations and contacts.
  • Viewer can look but not change anything.

The number of seats depends on your plan.

en.title: Inbox and contacts
en.description: Reply to customers, organise conversations and keep your contacts tidy.

articles.title: Work the shared inbox
articles.summary: Reply, assign and keep track of every conversation.
articles.html:
The Inbox shows every WhatsApp conversation, newest first.

Reply faster

  • Use quick replies for answers you send often.
  • Add internal notes so teammates see context without the customer seeing it.

Stay organised

  • Assign a conversation to a teammate so everyone knows who owns it.
  • Close conversations when they are resolved; they reopen if the customer writes again.

Never miss a message

Turn on the new-message sound and browser notifications under Settings, and the unread count shows in your browser tab.

articles.title: Import and tag contacts
articles.summary: Bring your customer list in from a spreadsheet and keep it organised.
articles.html:
Your Contacts page is the single list of everyone you talk to.

Import

  1. Prepare a CSV file with a name and a phone number in international format.
  2. Choose import on the Contacts page and upload the file.
  3. Review the preview, then confirm.

Organise

  • Add tags to group people, for example by product or city.
  • Use custom fields for details specific to your business.
  • Save a segment to reuse a filter, such as everyone with a given tag.

Phone fields use a country picker, so numbers are stored in a consistent format.

en.title: Broadcasts and automation
en.description: Reach many customers at once and let OgaDesk handle repetitive work.

articles.title: Send a broadcast
articles.summary: Message a group of contacts with an approved WhatsApp template.
articles.html:
Broadcasts let you send one message to many contacts.

Send

  1. Open Broadcasts and create a new one.
  2. Pick an approved template and fill in its variables.
  3. Choose your audience: a tag, a segment or a list of contacts.
  4. Send now or schedule it.

Rules to know

  • WhatsApp only allows business-started messages through approved templates.
  • Customers who opted out are skipped automatically.
  • Your plan sets how many broadcast recipients you can reach each month.

After sending, the broadcast page shows delivered, read and failed counts.

articles.title: Automate replies and follow-ups
articles.summary: Use automations, flows and AI agents to save your team time.
articles.html:
OgaDesk offers three ways to automate.

  • Automations run an action when something happens, such as tagging a new contact.
  • Flows guide a customer through a conversation step by step.
  • AI agents answer common questions from your knowledge library and hand over to a person when needed.

Start with one small automation, watch how it behaves in the inbox, then build on it.

en.title: Plans and partners
en.description: Understand plans, currencies and how to earn by referring others.

articles.title: Plans, limits and currency
articles.summary: What each plan includes and why prices show in your own currency.
articles.html:
Each plan sets limits such as WhatsApp numbers, seats, contacts and monthly messages. See them on the pricing section of the home page or under Settings → Billing.

Currency

Prices are set in naira. To make them easier to read, we show an approximate price in your own currency using a daily exchange rate. The amount you are actually charged is shown at checkout. Use the currency picker in the page header to switch.

Upgrading

When you reach a limit we tell you, and you can upgrade from the same screen.

articles.title: Earn with the partner program
articles.summary: Every customer has a referral link, live stats and a leaderboard spot.
articles.html:
Everyone with an OgaDesk account is automatically a partner.

How it works

  1. Open Partner program in the sidebar to find your personal link.
  2. Share it with businesses that sell or support customers on WhatsApp.
  3. Watch clicks, sign-ups and customers appear on your stats.

What you earn

Partners earn a percentage of eligible payments for a set number of months. The current rate and the earnings calculator are on the public partners page.

Good to know

  • Your first referral code wins: someone can only be referred once.
  • You cannot refer yourself.
  • Payouts open together with paid plans; tracking starts now.

en.title: Developers
en.description: Use the OgaDesk API and send one-time codes.

articles.title: Use the API
articles.summary: Create an API key and call OgaDesk from your own software.
articles.html:
The REST API lets your systems create contacts, read conversations and send messages.

Get a key

  1. Open Settings → API keys.
  2. Create a key and copy it. It is shown once, so store it safely.
  3. Send it with every request as described in the API docs.

Learn more

The full reference, with examples for each endpoint, is on the API docs page linked in the site footer.

Keep keys secret and rotate them if you think one has leaked.

articles.title: Send one-time codes (OTP)
articles.summary: Deliver login and verification codes over WhatsApp.
articles.html:
OgaDesk can deliver one-time codes through WhatsApp using an approved authentication template.

What you need

  • A connected WhatsApp number.
  • An approved authentication template.
  • An API key.

Your application requests a code, OgaDesk sends it to the customer's WhatsApp, and your application checks the code the customer types back. See the API docs for the exact calls.
